originality.rationale: FAIL (ADMISSION_DEFECT): Headline existence of explicit Ueda AFP (A rtimes Z)*_A (A rtimes Z) with unique Cartan is substantively implied by prior stronger general theorem Popa-Vaes, Acta Math. 212 (2014), arXiv:1111.6951: for ANY free ergodic pmp action F_n on (X,mu), 2<=n<=infinity, L^infty(X) rtimes F_n has L^infty(X) as unique Cartan up to unitary conjugacy. Bernoulli shift F2 on {0,1}^F2 is one such action, explicitly flagship-covered. The remaining identification M1*_A M2 ~= A rtimes (Z*Z)=A rtimes F2 is standard folklore via Voiculescu/Ueda universal property and Fourier expansion, not a new lemma. Ioana Ann. Sci. ENS (2015) independently covers Gamma=Z*Z AFP-group case with unique Cartan. Thus submitted claim is a direct corollary / parameter substitution n=2 plus Bernoulli choice of known stronger fact, i.e. recomputation/certificate/repackaging. Title similarity alone was not relied on; hypothesis-conclusion comparison shows coverage. Admission missed Popa-Vaes dominance while citing only Ioana-absence and BHR dichotomy as non-deciding, so admitted originality premise was materially false: ADMISSION_DEFECT.
